meta.title: Lower-extremity vascular duplex structured input spec

sources.S1: Arterial Doppler Waveform Analysis (22p, web-compiled review; secondary)
sources.S2: Kim ESH et al. SVM/SVU consensus on peripheral arterial and venous Doppler waveforms. Vasc Med 2020;25:484-506 (HAL AAM, PDF pages)
sources.S3: Radiology Key: Ultrasound Diagnosis of Venous Insufficiency (16p web capture; text truncated by paywall at p.15)
sources.S4: Dauplaise T. Venous Ultrasound 2nd ed., Ch.10 Interpretation/documentation/reporting (book pp.179-188)
sources.OUTSIDE SOURCE: Criterion not found in the 4 uploaded sources; default proposed, user decision required

meta.conventions: Each segment field is entered per side (Rt/Lt) unless 'per_side':false. 'not_visualized' on a segment suppresses all its findings and emits a limitation sentence.

arterial_grading_scheme.note: Boundary: S2 writes '>2' and '>4'; spec treats VR=2.0 as 50-74% and VR=4.0 as >=75% (user to confirm).

normal_low.source: S1 p.12 (0.9) adopted; S1 p.15 states 1.0

reflux_threshold_s.decision: User decision 2026-11-14: superficial & perforator >0.5 s, femoral/popliteal >1.0 s; pathologic perforator >=3.5 mm & >=0.5 s

superficial.source: S3 p.12 (normal saphenous valve closure <0.5 s standing); cutoff as reflux criterion: OUTSIDE SOURCE (Labropoulos 2003; SVS/AVF 2011)

dvt_include_calf_veins.decision: User decision 2026-11-14: whole-leg incl. calf veins

dvt_criteria.decision: User decision 2026-11-14: compressibility and acute/chronic criteria adopted from external guidelines
dvt_criteria.source: OUTSIDE SOURCE (Needleman L et al. SRU consensus, J Ultrasound Med 2018;37:1597-1608)

ceap_enabled.source: OUTSIDE SOURCE (CEAP 2020: Lurie F, et al. The 2020 update of the CEAP classification system and reporting standards. J Vasc Surg Venous Lymphat Disord 2020;8:342-352. doi:10.1016/j.jvsv.2019.12.075)

ceap.source: OUTSIDE SOURCE (Lurie F, et al. The 2020 update of the CEAP classification system and reporting standards. J Vasc Surg Venous Lymphat Disord 2020;8:342-352. doi:10.1016/j.jvsv.2019.12.075)
ceap.decision: User decision 2026-11-14: record per CEAP 2020; all C classes present are checked (advanced CEAP) and the single highest C is also reported (basic CEAP).

output_format.note: both = '{basic} (advanced: {advanced})'; advanced omitted when identical to basic

c_display_order.note: order of classes in the advanced C list

c_rank.decision: LOCAL CLINICAL DECISION (user, 2026-11-14): C4b > C4c > C4a for the basic 'highest C'
c_rank.note: Not defined by the paper (Table III listing order is stated not to be a severity scale; C4 subclasses unranked).

c_classes.C0: No visible or palpable signs of venous disease

c_modifier.note: subscript to the clinical class (Table III footnote); written as ',s' / ',a' after the C list, e.g. C2,4a,s

p_classes.advanced: Table V anatomic abbreviations listed under each P class, e.g. 'Pr GSVa, GSVb, CPV'; when both: 'Pr ...; Po ...' (separator not specified in paper - local convention)

segment_map.note: Table V abbreviations. GSV at knee level and knee perforators are not defined by the paper - mapped to GSVa/TPV by default (configurable). PAGSV and Giacomini are not listed - mapped to NSV.

rules.then: flag 'consistent with more proximal flow-limiting disease'

rules.if: no occlusion, no lesion >= 50%, all visualized segments multiphasic with rapid upstroke

templates.findings_segment: {Side} {segment_name}: {flow_direction}, {phasicity}, {resistance} resistive waveform with {upstroke} upstroke{modifiers_clause}; PSV {psv} cm/s{plaque_clause}.
templates.lesion: {Side} {segment_name}: focal stenosis with PSV {psv_lesion} cm/s (proximal reference {psv_ref} cm/s, velocity ratio {vr}), consistent with {grade} diameter stenosis.
templates.occlusion: {Side} {segment_name}: no flow detected, consistent with occlusion{length_clause}{reconst_clause}.
templates.imp_normal: {Side} lower extremity: no hemodynamically significant arterial stenosis or occlusion. Multiphasic waveforms throughout the visualized arterial segments.
templates.imp_inflow: {Side} CFA waveform with prolonged upstroke suggests proximal (aortoiliac) inflow disease.
templates.imp_distal_dampened: {Side} dampened monophasic waveforms in the {segments} suggest more proximal flow-limiting disease.
templates.imp_comparison: Compared with the prior study of {prior_exam_date}: {prior_change}.

basic = highest C by config.ceap.c_rank (local decision: C4b > C4c > C4a) + ',{s|a}'; advanced = 'C' + all selected classes in config.ceap.c_display_order (Table III order) joined by ',', leading C dropped after the first, + ',{s|a}'
rules.source: OUTSIDE SOURCE (CEAP 2020: basic = single highest C; advanced = all C present)

rules.then: As if any superficial reflux/thrombus (SFJ, GSV, AAGSV, PAGSV, TE, SPJ, SSV, SFJ tributaries); Ad if deep reflux or deep non-compressible; Ap if incompetent perforator; none -> An. Ordered s,d,p

Pr if any reflux; Po if any non-compressible (thrombus/post-thrombotic) segment; both -> Pr,o; none -> Pn. Advanced: 'Pr {segment abbreviations}; Po {segment abbreviations}' via config.ceap.segment_map. Treated/ablated segments excluded. Continuous CFV flow does NOT auto-add Po (warning only).
override replaces the auto value (prefix A/P added if missing)
C not selected; s/a not selected; C0 with other classes; C2+C2r or C6+C6r both selected; deep thrombus with Ep (consider Esi); central CFV pattern without Po

templates.technique: Duplex ultrasound of the {laterality_lc} lower extremity venous system was performed in the {reflux_position_lc} position. Reflux was assessed using {maneuver_method_lc}. Reflux criteria: superficial and perforator veins > {thr_sup} s, femoral/popliteal veins > {thr_deep} s.
templates.deep_normal: {Side}: The deep veins (CFV, FV, POPV) are compressible and patent with spontaneous respirophasic flow and no deep venous reflux.
templates.perforator: {Side} {group} perforator at {distance} cm, diameter {diameter} mm, outward flow {outflow_time} s, connecting to the {connects}: {perf_status}.
templates.varicosity: {Side} varicosities in the {location} (up to {diameter} mm), fed by the {source}.
templates.imp_sfj_gsv: {Side}: SFJ incompetence with GSV reflux from the SFJ to the {distal_level} (GSV diameter {dmin}-{dmax} mm).
templates.imp_segmental_gsv: {Side}: Segmental GSV reflux at the {levels} with a competent SFJ{source_clause}.
templates.imp_tributary: {Side}: Reflux in SFJ tributaries with a competent terminal valve.
templates.imp_spj_ssv: {Side}: SPJ incompetence with SSV reflux to the {distal_level} (SSV diameter {dmax} mm).
templates.imp_no_deep: {Side}: No deep venous reflux. No evidence of deep vein thrombosis.
templates.imp_normal: {Side}: No significant superficial or deep venous reflux.
templates.imp_central: {Side}: Continuous CFV flow suggests more central (iliocaval) venous obstruction or extrinsic compression; further evaluation of the iliac veins/IVC is recommended.
templates.imp_pulsatile: Pulsatile CFV waveforms may reflect elevated central venous pressure; correlate with cardiac status.
templates.imp_source_unknown: Source of reflux for the {location} varicosities was not identified.
templates.imp_ceap_example: Right CEAP 2020: C4a,s Ep As,p Pr (advanced: C2,3,4a,s Ep As,p Pr GSVa, GSVb, SSV, CPV).
templates.imp_sup_thrombus: {Side} non-compressible {segments}, suspicious for superficial vein thrombosis.

dvt.segments_note: proximal = popliteal and above; distal = calf veins (definition OUTSIDE SOURCE). Calf veins shown if config.dvt_include_calf_veins. Contralateral CFV mandatory for unilateral study (S4 Venous Ultrasound 2e Ch.10 p.183).

rules.if: compressibility in [partially, non-compressible] OR thrombus != none

classify: proximal DVT (POPV and above) / distal (calf) DVT / superficial vein thrombosis

acute if majority of [hypoechoic, distended, free-floating tail, smooth] and none of [wall thickening, synechiae, recanalization, collaterals, contracted]; chronic/post-thrombotic if majority of the latter; else 'indeterminate age'
add 'free-floating thrombus tail' to impression

rules.if: CFV/EIV flow_pattern=='continuous' OR spontaneity=='non-spontaneous' with no thrombus at/below sample site to explain
rules.then: 'suggests more central (iliocaval) obstruction or extrinsic compression; consider iliac vein/IVC imaging'
rules.source: S2 SVM/SVU Consensus 2020 Table 9 p.35; S2 SVM/SVU Consensus 2020 p.11

rules.then: 'reduced augmentation suggests obstruction between the sampling site and the compression site'
rules.source: definition S2 SVM/SVU Consensus 2020 Table 5 p.29; interpretation OUTSIDE SOURCE

rules.then: 'pulsatile venous flow may reflect elevated central venous pressure'

rules.if: laterality unilateral AND contralateral CFV not entered
rules.then: validation warning
superficial vein thrombosis; report distance to SFJ/SPJ
compare: new / extension / unchanged / partial recanalization / resolved
rules.source: S4 Venous Ultrasound 2e Ch.10 p.183; S2 SVM/SVU Consensus 2020 p.15

templates.technique: Duplex ultrasound with compression and color/spectral Doppler of the {laterality_lc} lower extremity deep veins{calf_clause}.
templates.seg_normal_group: {Side}: The {segment_list} are fully compressible with normal color filling.
templates.imp_negative: {Side}: No evidence of deep vein thrombosis.
templates.imp_dvt: {Side}: {age} {occlusion} deep vein thrombosis involving the {segment_list} ({level} DVT){tail_clause}.
templates.imp_svt: {Side} superficial vein thrombosis of the {segment_name}, thrombus apex {thrombus_ext} cm from the {saphenofemoral|saphenopopliteal} junction.
templates.imp_svt_policy: No DVT-equivalence statement is generated for superficial vein thrombosis; distance to SFJ/SPJ is recorded only and management is left to clinical judgment (user decision 2026-11-14). Warning if distance not entered.
templates.imp_central: {Side}: Continuous/non-spontaneous CFV flow suggests more central (iliocaval) venous obstruction or extrinsic compression; consider iliac vein/IVC imaging.
templates.imp_pulsatile: Pulsatile CFV waveforms may reflect elevated central venous pressure.
templates.imp_comparison: Compared with the prior study of {prior_exam_date}: {prior_change}.

order: Sonographer / Interpreting physician / Date of interpretation
report_layout.source: S4 Venous Ultrasound 2e Ch.10 pp.182-183; S2 SVM/SVU Consensus 2020 p.15

storage.decision: User decision 2026-11-14 (solo research use): pseudonymized save to own Google Sheet. Name and date of birth are not collected at all; sonographer/physician names are not stored.

target.layout: wide: one row per exam, one column per field, Rt/Lt per segment ('{Rt|Lt}_{segment}_{field}')

stored: all segment inputs per side (non-examined side blank; contralateral CFV kept)

auto-interpretation: {side}_{seg}_reflux_auto (venous), {side}_{seg}_thrombus_auto (DVT), ABI_{side} + ABI_{side}_class, lesions_json with vr/grade_auto (arterial), CEAP_{side}_basic / CEAP_{side}_advanced (venous)
report_text_final (text in the report box, examiner names scrubbed)
input_json (full input of the exam for re-import; sonographer/physician removed)

transport.endpoint: Google Apps Script web app bound to the sheet (apps_script/Code.gs), Execute as: Me, Who has access: Anyone
transport.request: fetch POST, Content-Type text/plain;charset=utf-8 (simple request: no CORS preflight), JSON body {secret, action: ping|check|save, sheet, key{reg_no,exam_date,exam_type}, mode: overwrite|append, columns[], values[]}
transport.auth: shared secret generated by setup() and stored in Script Properties; typed once into the page and kept in browser localStorage together with the URL (the only localStorage use)
server_rules: only ping/check/save; never returns stored rows
header row auto-extends with new columns
cells written as plain text (keeps leading zeros)

client_rules: Registration No. and exam date required to save
duplicate check -> confirm overwrite latest row / append new row / cancel
success and failure shown in the report card status line + toast
